recruiterCard.summary: Built an auditable reconciliation workflow, demonstrated on synthetic data, that aligns multi-source records, enforces schemas, and reports exceptions.
impactBullets: Built reconciliation pipelines across multi-source datasets that match records and surface exceptions for review.
Generated audit-trail reports with schema enforcement, validation checks, and traceability logging.
Structured the workflow to make exceptions visible while keeping the core process repeatable and reliable.
